review:
Classic Big Bass on a 5x3, 10-line grid – tackle symbols, a dragonfly, and fish that carry cash for the angler to collect once the bonus starts.

Up to 20 free spins from one trigger, and Golden Wilds are the new addition. Collecting fishermen moves you up levels with bigger multipliers, which is where the 10,000x max comes from. Fast and simple, with a higher ceiling than the original. 96.07% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
